main.description: A Markdown article belonging to a publication. Presence of this record in a repository makes the article public; drafts are not represented as records.

publication.description: AT URI of the app.nooker.publication record this article belongs to. This is the stable reference; presentation URLs must not be used. If the referenced record does not exist, the article remains schema-valid but is excluded from rendered pages and feeds.

content.description: Article body as Markdown text (CommonMark plus GFM tables and strikethrough). No image, media, or attachment semantics in this revision.

slug.description: URL path segment for the article, unique within its publication. Lowercase ASCII letters, digits, and hyphens; must not start or end with a hyphen. Mutable presentation attribute; uniqueness is enforced by the publishing service, not by this schema.

updatedAt.description: Client-declared time of the most recent content update (RFC 3339).
